provenance.model_description: Deterministic procedural simulation of Jezero Crater morphology (rim, delta, floor, Belva)
provenance.official_source_counterpart: MOLA/HRSC Blended DEM & CTX/HiRISE Jezero Mosaic
provenance.intended_use: Deterministic algorithm verification, test suite execution, frontend integration sandbox
provenance.warning: Do NOT use synthetic test data for operational flight planning or genuine mission risk assessment.

limitations: Pilot demonstration is currently operating on deterministic synthetic test fixture.
Elevation grid resolution (112.5m/px) does not resolve sub-pixel rock or sand ripple hazards.
Calculations represent routing optimization priority models, not certified human EVA guarantees.
